这里有点乱，不过反叛者倒是很喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
This place will be used as a base while you carry out your other duties.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
你处理其他事务时，可以把这里当作据点。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Anyhow, I've analyzed all the information gathered from the last operation.
It turns out there are more facilities with secret laboratories.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
总之，我已经分析了上次行动收集到的所有情报。
结果发现还有更多设施设有秘密实验室。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
We already expected as much when we started our research.
It's not just speculation this time, the evidence is clear now.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
我们一开始调查时就预料到这种情况了。
这次不是推测，证据已经确凿。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Elena Volkova is organizing an recon team for investigating the suspected areas.
I think it would greatly help if you joined her team too..
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
埃琳娜·沃尔科娃正在组织侦察队，调查可疑地点。
如果你能加入她的队伍，肯定会很有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Hey~ Tes!
We sent a recon team to investigate the areas you spoke about.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃尔科娃]
嘿，泰斯！
我们已经派侦察队去调查你提到的那些地点了。

scripts.text: Where is it?
scripts.translation: 在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Oh you're the adventurer? Did Tes call you?
It really help if someone as strong as you joined us.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃尔科娃]
你就是那位冒险者吧？泰斯叫你来的？
有你这样强的人加入，肯定能帮上大忙。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Are you really sure about this place?
Lucky said it's just an abandoned smelting plant after a mine close.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃尔科娃]
你确定是这里吗？
拉基说，这只是矿场关闭后废弃的一座冶炼厂。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
I know it doesn't look like much,
but thanks to the previous data collected by the Werner Institute...
We found an entry to the ^4D4DFFAbandoned Waste of Rudus^000000.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
我知道这里看起来不起眼，
但多亏沃纳研究所之前收集的数据...
我们找到了通往^4D4DFF鲁杜斯废弃垃圾场^000000的入口。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
We figured out a path or a location to get inside, so I'd like you to investigate it further.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
我们找到了进入那里的路线和入口，想请你继续调查。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Anyway, so this area with all the experiments?
Then I'll go to the field.
The adventurer should come after me.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃尔科娃]
所以实验都在这片区域进行？
那我先去现场。
冒险者随后跟上来。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Then I'll inform the adventurer of your location separately.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
我会另外通知冒险者你的所在地。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Leave it to me.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃尔科娃]
交给我吧。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Why not join us and see the situation for yourself?
The location is Einbroch North-East field. The code name for the operating system is Rudus.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
为什么不加入我们，亲自看看情况？
地点在艾音布罗克东北野外，行动代号是“鲁杜斯”。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
I'll call this location <NAVI>[Rudus]<INFO>ein_fild05,158,284,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> from now on.
I would be grateful if you joined.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
以后我就把这里称为<NAVI>[鲁杜斯]<INFO>ein_fild05,158,284,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。
你愿意加入的话，我会非常感激。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
In the meantime, I will try and learn more about Lighthalzen.
You should received enough information to start investigating now.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
我会趁这段时间继续调查里希塔乐镇。
你已经掌握了足够的信息，可以开始行动了。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
<NAVI>[Rudus]<INFO>ein_fild05,158,284,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> is at Einbroch North-East field.
If you join the recon team, it will definitely help.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
<NAVI>[鲁杜斯]<INFO>ein_fild05,158,284,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>位于艾音布罗克东北野外。
如果你加入侦察队，一定会很有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
You went there?
Hmm, so you've found in the barrier in the closed mine, and there are monsters behind it?
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
你去过那里了？
嗯，你在封闭矿场发现了一道屏障，后面还有魔物？

scripts.text:
[Tes]
I don't think it's a research facility, even by looking at the other member's report.
It seems to be a place to cover up unsuccessful experiments.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
看过其他成员的报告后，我还是不觉得那是研究设施。
那里似乎是用来掩盖失败实验的地方。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
For some reason, there's been no accident on the outside. Tsk.
For the time being, I think I'm going to split from the rebellions.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
奇怪的是，外面并没有发生任何事故。啧。
眼下我打算暂时退出反叛者的行动。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Unfortunately, Rudus didn't bring out great results. Volkova has been quite helpful.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
可惜鲁杜斯那边没什么重大发现。不过沃尔科娃帮了不少忙。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
I'll have to go to the backdoor now room now.
It seems I've picked up bad customers, but with the adventurer's help it shouldn't be a problem.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
我现在得去后面的房间。
看来我招来了一些难缠的客人，不过有冒险者帮忙，应该没问题。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
It's that room over there. It's a place where only rebellions leaders can go in or out.
All the captains are inside.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
就是那边的房间，只有反叛者的首领能进出。
各位队长都在里面。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
It's the building at the top left of our Headquarters, in <NAVI>[Lighthalzen]<INFO>lighthalzen,56,270,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
There will be Rekenber guards sent by Aas and troop dispatched by the republic.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
就在我们总部左上方，位于<NAVI>[里希塔乐镇]<INFO>lighthalzen,56,270,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>的那栋建筑。
阿斯会派雷肯贝尔卫兵来，共和国也会派出部队。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Est will also be there, you'll find the location easily.
I hope this mission goes well.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
埃斯特也会在那里，很容易找到。
希望任务顺利。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
You're back.
Est came back first and I wasn't sure something had happened to you.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
你回来了。
埃斯特先回来了，我还担心你是不是出了什么事。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
The information I got from Est was incredible.
And it seems Lazy has something to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
埃斯特带回来的消息令人难以置信。
而且懒散似乎有话要告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Kaya should be there too.
I have to analyze the data everyone is giving me, it's piling up.
You have enough to do already.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
卡雅应该也在那里。
大家送来的数据堆积如山，我得赶紧分析。
你已经够忙了。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Is it related to the laboratory's security.
Aas told me you had something to deliver.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
这和实验室的安保有关吗？
阿斯说你有东西要交给我。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
I think it's a conscious decision from Schlein to have left these documents.
Tsk, that Schlein.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
我想施莱因是故意留下这些文件的。
啧，施莱因那家伙。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
I understand.
I will analyze this along with the other materials.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
我明白了。
我会把这些资料和其他材料一起分析。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Lazy seems to be up to something.
He's somewhere here in the pub, go and find him.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
懒散好像在搞什么名堂。
他应该就在酒馆里，去找找他。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
I thought you were investigating with Lazy, it looks like you didn't get great results.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
我以为你在和懒散一起调查，看来结果并不理想。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
I finished analyzing the information you gathered from Regenschirm earlier, there were traces of supplies and research data.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
我已经分析完你之前从雷根修芦带回的信息，发现了物资和研究数据的线索。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
So far, I believe it was a trick from the Enterprise, from those who sit back at the company.
Huh...
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
目前看来，这是雷肯贝尔公司内部高层策划的阴谋。
唉...

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I agree with your assessment.
The more I learn about the truth, the less I understand what's going on.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我同意你的看法。
我越是了解真相，就越搞不清楚到底发生了什么。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
What I've seen so far was only the tip of the iceberg.
My eyes are now wide opened.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我之前看到的不过是冰山一角。
如今我也看清了许多。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
It seems it was from the group that pretended to be part of the security personnel and then attacked the laboratory.
What could their motives be?
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
看来是那群伪装成安保人员、随后袭击实验室的人干的。
他们到底有什么目的？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Tsk, I think I know who's behind all of this.
There have only been a few people who have ran unreasonable experiments at the laboratory.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
啧，我想我知道幕后黑手是谁了。
在实验室做过不合理实验的，也就那么几个人。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
We had fired them because of their unethical experiments, I'm guessing it's them.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我们曾因他们进行不道德实验而将其解雇。我猜就是他们。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Hmm... That part of the investigation still needs more clarity.
I'm going to try and find more information about the new laboratories.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
嗯...这部分还得继续调查，弄清楚来龙去脉。
我会继续搜集新实验室的情报。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I will leave this part to you.
I'm going back to my laboratory and do some research.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
这部分就交给你了。
我要回自己的实验室做些研究。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Please excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
失陪了。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
... then I'll keep you informed about the next operation.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
...我会把下一次行动的消息告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
There is another closed mine at Einbroch, in the North-West region.
There are many abandoned mines in the area...
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
艾音布罗克西北方向还有一座封闭的矿场。
那一带有不少废弃矿场...

scripts.text:
[Tes]
I should have looked at them more, but I don't have enough resources...
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
我本该多调查一下，可手头资源不够...

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Anyway, this time around, the elders of the Rebellion are going to participate in the operation.
They are very strong supporters.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
总之，这次行动会有反叛者的长老参与。
他们会大力支持我们。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Meet with a <NAVI>[Rebellion Crew]<INFO>ein_fild03,278,269,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> member at the North-West region of Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
去艾音布罗克西北区域，与<NAVI>[反叛者成员]<INFO>ein_fild03,278,269,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>会合。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Meet with a <NAVI>[Rebellion Crew]<INFO>ein_fild03,278,269,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> member at the North-West region of Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
去艾音布罗克西北区域，与<NAVI>[反叛者成员]<INFO>ein_fild03,278,269,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>会合。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
I'm a bit tired. There are tons of documents to analyze.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
我有点累了，还有一大堆文件要分析。

scripts.text:
[Est]
It's your operation. Do you have no support available?
How the hell you become a government without an army?
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
这是你们的行动，难道没有支援吗？
没有军队，你们怎么治理一个国家？

scripts.text:
[Tes]
I can't say anything about that.
I don't have the authority to create and grow my own army.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
这件事我无可奉告。
我没有权力建立和扩充自己的军队。

scripts.text:
[Est]
I know. I can't ask that to a general soldier.
You don't have the power to change that.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
我知道，我不该要求一个普通士兵回答这种问题。
你也没有权力改变现状。

scripts.text: Why are you all here?!
scripts.translation: 你们为什么都在这里？！

scripts.text:
[Est]
Right? Isn't it weird for you too?
It's really strange for us as well, are you aware of what's going on adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
对吧？你也觉得奇怪吧？
我们也觉得不可思议。冒险者，你知道到底发生什么了吗？

scripts.text:
[Est]
It's impressive how they've managed to make this meeting inside the pub will all of us, and now a Rebellion unit is helping out the Enterprise.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
他们居然能把我们所有人都召集到酒馆开会，真够厉害的。现在反叛者的小队竟然还在协助雷肯贝尔公司。

scripts.text:
[Est]
Isn't it truly wonderful and amazing? I've seen many things, but I never thought that this day would come.
But why are you here?
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
这不是很奇妙、很了不起吗？我见过不少事情，却从没想过会有这么一天。
不过，你为什么在这里？

scripts.text:
[Middle-Aged Man]
Sigh.. I don't know why we're so hostile with each other.
Still, there are only few organizations that contribute to the people...
scripts.translation:
[中年男子]
唉...我不明白我们为什么总是彼此敌视。
毕竟，真正为民众做事的组织也没几个...

scripts.text:
[Est]
Do you really believe so?
Don't you know why we're called the Rebellion in the first place?
You're only thinking about what you want.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
你真这么想？
你不知道反叛者这个名字是怎么来的吗？你只考虑自己想要什么。

scripts.text:
[Est]
Yeah. That's a corporation. How many companies do you have now?
Your president always look down on us.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
没错，你们是家公司。现在你们有多少家分公司？
你们的总裁一直瞧不起我们。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
That's not it, Est.
You do know there's a reason for that, right?
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
不是这样的，埃斯特。
你知道这是有原因的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Est]
I've already decided to send a support unit.
Even so, is that really going to be enough?
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
我已经决定派一支支援小队了。
可这样真的够吗？

scripts.text: So what's going on?
scripts.translation: 那么到底发生了什么？

scripts.text:
[Est]
I'm a little too excited. I'll shut up. Tes, explain it please.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
我有点太激动了，还是闭嘴吧。泰斯，你来说明情况。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
To put it simply, our affiliated Enterprise research institute, Regenschirm, is occupied by a large group of enemies.
A special unit under Est's command will be dispatched for the recapture.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
简单来说，我们旗下的雷根修芦研究所被一大群敌人占领了。
埃斯特会派出一支特别小队，夺回研究所。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
So that's why Est was so nervous.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
所以埃斯特才那么紧张。

scripts.text: Why aren't the Enterprise guards helping?
scripts.translation: 为什么企业的卫兵不帮忙？

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Well you see...
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
嗯，你看...

scripts.text:
[Aas]
It all started because of the traitor within the guards.
Oh, sorry, I'm senior Rekenber security officer, Aas.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
这一切都是因为安保部队里出了叛徒。
哦，对了，我是雷肯贝尔高级安保人员阿斯。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
The traitor is the chief security officer, Schlein, who has substantial support within the guard forces.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
叛徒就是安保主任施莱因，他在卫兵队伍里有不少支持者。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
It's these guards, let by Schlein,
Who currently occupies the Regenschirm.
Most of the armed forced join with Schlein, and they started calling themselves Heart Hunters.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
目前占领雷根修芦的，正是施莱因率领的那群卫兵。
大部分武装人员都投靠了施莱因，并自称“心之猎手”。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Yes. It was the Heart Hunters.
On the day of the incident, at midnight, the guards changed uniform for something unusual.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
是的，他们就是心之猎手。
事发当晚，卫兵们在午夜换上了奇怪的新制服。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
In the daytime, our team is in charge of patrols and security. At nighttime, the security guards of Schlein take over.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
白天由我们负责巡逻和安保，到了晚上就由施莱因的卫兵接班。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
The shifts scheduled for that day came in wearing new uniforms, it was a mistake for me to believe it was an experimental outfit.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
那天值夜班的卫兵穿着新制服来接班，我还以为那只是实验服，结果完全判断错了。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
They seized the daytime crew in an instant.
With their deception, they took all over the security guards simultaneously.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
他们瞬间制服了白班人员。
接着又用诡计同时控制了所有安保人员。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
I tried to send an emergency request to get a response team, but they are extraordinarily strong...
Only more guards ended up being sacrificed and we didn't have any success.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
我试着发出紧急求援信号，请求派救援队来，但他们实在太强了...
结果只是更多卫兵牺牲，我们还是没能成功。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
And the one responsible for this was Schlein, showing up in a new uniform.
He asked me if I wanted to become stronger. If I accepted his offer, I would become a Heart Hunter too.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
这一切都是施莱因策划的。他穿着新制服现身，问我想不想变强。要是接受他的提议，我也会成为心之猎手。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
I refused and left, only to watch more guards suffering.
Most of my crew suffered huge casualties, as I just stood by in shame...
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
我拒绝后离开了，却只能眼睁睁看着更多卫兵受苦。
我的队伍伤亡惨重，而我只能羞愧地站在一旁...

scripts.text:
[Aas]
The guards wearing the new uniform, who followed Schlein, may not have all been Heart Hunters.
Schlein only gathers the strongest people after all.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
那些跟随施莱因、穿着新制服的卫兵，不一定全是心之猎手。
毕竟施莱因只会招揽最强的人。

scripts.text: I've met Heart Hunters too...
scripts.translation: 我也遇到过心之猎手...

scripts.text:
[Est]
Did you see any more Heart Hunters?
Weren't those guards we fought in the battlefield some time ago?
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
你还见过其他心之猎手？
他们不就是我们之前在战场上交手的那些卫兵吗？

scripts.text:
[Est]
If our opponents are Heart Hunters, that's interesting.
I should be able to handle them quickly.
I'll go first.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
如果对手是心之猎手，那倒有意思。
我应该很快就能收拾他们。
我先上。

scripts.text:
[Est]
There, what do you say Aas?
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
好了，阿斯，你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Yes? Yes! How can I help you with that?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
嗯？嗯！你们要我怎么帮忙？

scripts.text:
[Est]
Couldn't you just have said that?
Are you afraid of these guards?
Don't you think we should go now, after you tell us the way?
Come on? Like the first operation we did.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
你刚才直接说不就行了吗？
你怕这些卫兵？
告诉我们路线后，大家马上出发不就好了？
就像上次行动那样。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Yes. I see. You're right.
I should go and explain the situation in more details...
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
是，我明白了。你说得对。
我该去把情况详细说明一下...

scripts.text:
[Middle-Aged Man]
Don't worry about me.
Is it safe for me to stay here?
I have something I must do. You do what you have to do on your end.
scripts.translation:
[中年男子]
不用担心我。
我留在这里安全吗？
我有必须做的事，你们也去做自己该做的事吧。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Roger. Then I will discuss strategies with Est.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
明白。那我去和埃斯特商量一下策略。

scripts.text:
[Est]
Tes, watch out your back. Haha, you'll be alright.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
泰斯，小心背后。哈哈，放心吧，你不会有事的。

scripts.text:
[Middle-Aged Man]
It all went so fast.
I wish we could talk more in-depth about this operation.
scripts.translation:
[中年男子]
事情发生得太快了。
真希望能更深入地讨论这次行动。

scripts.text:
[Middle-Aged Man]
I don't think I should be starting this conversation, so why do not you speak with Tes instead?
scripts.translation:
[中年男子]
这话题还是不该由我先提。你们去和泰斯谈谈吧。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Now I can formally introduce myself.
My name is Kaya. I work with the Rekenber Division.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
现在我可以正式自我介绍了。
我叫卡雅，隶属于雷肯贝尔部门。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
There aren't a lot of security personal remaining in the Enterprise, because most of them betrayed Rekenber.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
雷肯贝尔公司剩下的安保人员不多了，因为大多数人都背叛了公司。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
So now, the rest of us are doing our best to shutdown Regenschirm...
I've sent help requests here and there, but I haven't gotten a good replies yet.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
所以现在我们剩下的人正尽力关闭雷根修芦...
我已经四处请求支援，但还没收到什么像样的回复。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
An unusually large number of companies have contacted the Rekenber directly for support.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
最近有很多公司直接联系雷肯贝尔请求支援，数量多得反常。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
But as a general soldier in the Schwartz Republic, it was too difficult to handle it ourselves and eventually we took advantage of the Rebellion and the adventurer's strength.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
可我只是修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的一名普通士兵，我们实在难以独自应对，最后只好借助反叛者和冒险者的力量。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I can understand why Est was so angry.
There are many people who are blind to the corrupt management and others who work on their own accord.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我理解埃斯特为什么那么生气。
有些人对腐败的管理视而不见，另一些人则擅自行动。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I've came here to purge the evil from the Enterprise.
However, I hadn't realize these rotten people were so deeply connected in politics.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我来这里是想铲除雷肯贝尔公司里的腐败势力。
但我没想到，这些人竟然在政界盘根错节。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
The citizen's safety is threatened,
they don't know what the enterprise is thinking. Neither can they officially seek and request help.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
市民的安全受到威胁，
他们不知道雷肯贝尔公司在打什么算盘，也没法通过正式渠道求助。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Sigh, wait.
You're not wrong, of course, but there are separate reasons for this.
It look like your sister has made some kind of deal with the president.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
唉，等等。
你说得没错，不过这背后另有原因。
看来你姐姐和总裁达成了某种协议。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
No, it wouldn't have been necessary to make such a deal if the right people were governing in the first place!
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
不，如果一开始就是合适的人在管理，根本不需要达成这种协议！

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Don't you think if the Enterprise had managed its properly to begin with, we wouldn't be in this situation right now?
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
你不觉得，要是雷肯贝尔公司一开始管理得当，我们就不会落到今天这个地步吗？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
.....
I'm sorry, I got worked up.
With our plan in action, I believe we have a better future ahead of us.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
...
抱歉，我有点激动了。
等我们的计划实施，我相信未来会变得更好。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
I agree, we have to act quickly though.
So {0},
If possible, could you join Est and do some planning?
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
我也这么认为，不过我们得尽快行动。
那么，{0}，
你能加入埃斯特那边，一起制定计划吗？

scripts.text:
[Tes]
As said they were called 'Heart Hunters'.
Maybe there is a connection with the previous incident. There maybe additional information we can send to Rune-Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
正如之前所说，他们被称为“心之猎手”。
这也许和之前的事件有关，我们或许能把更多情报送到米德加尔特。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Kaya and I will stay here to process and relay the incoming information.
I will leave the battle side of things to you and Est.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
卡雅和我会留在这里处理并转发收到的情报。
战斗方面就交给你和埃斯特了。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Please take care.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
保重。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
I'll see you outside.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
我在外面等你。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I'm sorry I can't help you anymore.
I think it may turn into a messy fight.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
抱歉，接下来我帮不上忙了。
恐怕会演变成一场混战。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Oh, hello there! My name is Aas from the Rekenber Security.
I'm currently here as Kaya Tos's bodyguard
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
你好！我是雷肯贝尔安保部的阿斯。
目前负责保护卡雅·托斯。

scripts.text:
[Est]
Why should we help them?
Can you explain why we have to cooperate with them?
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
我们为什么要帮他们？
你能解释一下我们为什么要和他们合作吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Look, that's all nice and good to have ^0000CDfacts^000000. But this is not even something you can use as a firepower.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
听着，^0000CD事实^000000当然重要，可光靠事实没法打仗。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I've said it a few times already.
This is it, those are all the ^0000CDfacts.^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我已经说过好几次了。
就是这样，这些就是所有的^0000CD事实。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Truth be told, it doesn't sound convincing. If I look at the front page of your report, it does not at all align with my investigation results.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
说实话，这些话没什么说服力。我看了你们报告的首页，内容和我的调查结果完全对不上。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
If that's the case, then we should review the investigation methods and the credibility of the source.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
如果是这样，那么我们应该审查调查方法和消息来源的可信度。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Oh sure, I have a lunch menu survey from the people in the neighborhood... is that what you want to use as facts?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
当然有啊，我还做了份附近居民的午餐菜单调查...你要拿这个当证据吗？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
That's not what I said at all...
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我根本不是那个意思...

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
What, you don't believe me? Yeah? Is that it? You don't think it's a reliable source of information?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
什么，你不信我？是吗？难道你觉得这不是可靠的消息来源？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Isn't it common sense that ^0000CDpeople inside the Enterprise know more?^000000
Not only would we have access to more data, but the quality would be much higher than what's available to an outsider.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
^0000CD雷肯贝尔公司内部的人知道得更多^000000，这不是常识吗？
我们能接触更多资料，质量也比外人能拿到的高得多。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Don't you think the Vice President would only share with us ^0000CDwhat he want us to know?^000000
Am I supposed to suspend all critical thinking and unquestioningly believe you?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你不觉得副总裁只会告诉我们^0000CD他想让我们知道的事^000000吗？
难道我要放弃思考，无条件相信你们？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Won't that mean you can just report to the President and hide a plan from us? Yeah? Right?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这样一来，你们不就能直接向总裁汇报，还对我们隐瞒计划了吗？对吧？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I never said that.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我从来没这么说过。

scripts.text: Lazy, what's wrong?
scripts.translation: 懒散，你怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Adventurer? Adventurer!! Hey, I haven't died yet!! Never been better!!
Listen to me.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
冒险者？冒险者！！喂，我还没死呢！！我好得很！！
听我说。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Lazy? Is your name Lazy? Didn't you introduce yourself as Daisy?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
懒散？那是你的名字吗？你刚才不是自称黛西吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Oh, that? Don't worry about it, it's the name I use to distract people. There, now you know me. Oh by the way... never mind, you don't need to know that.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哦，那个啊？别担心，那只是我用来转移别人注意力的名字。好了，现在你知道我是谁了。对了...算了，你不用知道。

scripts.text: If it's Daisy... are you a flower?
scripts.translation: 如果是戴西...你是花儿吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Look, although it may be true in my case, it doesn't mean it applies to me.
Don't take it too personal. Who in the world only has one name?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
听着，我身上或许真有点花的特质，但不代表我就是花。别太往心里去。谁会只有一个名字？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
If you don't have anything else to say, then please explain why your name is different.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
如果你没别的要说，就解释一下为什么你用了不同的名字。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I was born to talk about it, but who are you talking about?
I have so many things to talk about. I can talk about them all day long.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我本来就很能说，不过你到底在说什么？
我有太多话题了，讲上一整天都行。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Now, as you know, this conversation is business meeting, aren't the Vice President's underlings standing right behind you?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你也知道，现在是在开工作会议。副总裁的下属不就站在你身后吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
It's already known to our neighbors that Rekenber was performing illegal experiments. Maybe the people on this list could have also been involved.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
附近的人都知道雷肯贝尔公司在进行非法实验。名单上的人说不定也牵涉其中。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Don't you want to clear their suspicions? Get their cooperation to know what's in your backyard?
If it were up to me, I'd have done that already. When else would we get such an opportunity?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你不想消除他们的疑虑吗？让他们配合，就能查清你们后院究竟藏着什么。
换作是我，早就这么做了。这样的机会还能有几次？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
What more are you hiding in your backyard? Are you not here for asking our help? If there's anything hidden over there,
wouldn't the Vice President be in trouble?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你们后院还藏着什么？你们不是来找我们帮忙的吗？要是那边藏了什么，
副总裁岂不是会惹上麻烦？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Requesting help and analyzing paperwork are separate matters.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
寻求帮助和分析文件是两回事。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Is it a separate matter because you said so? When did you decide that?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你说是两回事就是两回事吗？谁定的规矩？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Now this has turned into a matter of trust, not merely a question about people missing!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
现在这成了信任问题，不只是有人失踪的问题！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Until we deal with these documents, how do you expect us to trust you?
Why would you assume so? Nobody here believe you?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
在我们查清这些文件之前，你凭什么要我们信任你？
你为什么会这么想？难道在场的人都不相信你吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
So here's the real question! How can we really cooperate with you if we don't have trust between us?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
问题就在这里！如果彼此不信任，我们怎么合作？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
These are the official documents from the Rekenber investigation.
Whether you believe it or not, Daisy, I don't know how else to clear your doubts.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
这些是雷肯贝尔调查的正式文件。
黛西，不管你信不信，我也不知道还能怎么消除你的疑虑。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
So you searched into the Enterprise very thoroughly and your information is ^0000CD100% reliable.^000000
So we have to believe it unconditionally. Isn't that strange? Do you have no evidence?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
所以你们把公司查得一清二楚，手里的情报还^0000CD百分之百可靠。^000000
然后我们就得无条件相信？这难道不奇怪吗？你们有证据吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I mean, if this document is credible at anyway, then you're calling me a liar, Vice President!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我的意思是，如果这份文件可信，那你就是在说我撒谎了，副总裁！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Oh... this is sudden. Should I seek the cooperation of the Vice President after I've been called a liar?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哦...真够突然的。既然你说我是骗子，我还怎么和副总裁合作？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I never called you a liar...
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我从来没说你是骗子...

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
No that's not it. You're requesting our cooperation, and asking us to trust you completely without any real evidence. How can we believe you?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
不，不是那样。你要求我们合作，却要求我们在没有任何实际证据的情况下完全信任你。我们怎么能相信你？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Now, even if you actively cooperate with me, it's hard for me to like trust this arrangement.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
现在，就算你积极配合，我也很难相信这种安排。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
You're repeating yourself now. I assure you, you can trust the documents.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
你又在重复刚才的话了。我向你保证，这些文件可信。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Why would I believe in you if you don't believe in me? I'm a compassionate person, patient and very humane.
Are your eyes so shut that you can't see what's in front of you?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你不相信我，我为什么要相信你？我可是个有同情心、耐心又通情达理的人。
你们是闭着眼睛吗？连眼前的事实都看不到？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Now you're going too far!
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
你太过分了！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Don't worry, it's alright. You know it's all true.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
别担心，没事的。你知道我说的都是真的。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Why, what's the matter with you?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
为什么，你怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Vice President, do you think that's right?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
副总裁，你觉得这样对吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
No? Well that's alright with me.
I'm fine.
I'm not blind. Even in my position, I've noticed the Enterprise is hiding something from us!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
不？那也无所谓。
我没事。
我又不瞎，就算身在公司内部，也看得出雷肯贝尔在隐瞒什么！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Anyway, Vice President, I know how people like you are, I'll give my report and I'll do things my own way.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
总之，副总裁，我知道你们这种人是什么样的。我会提交报告，也会按自己的方式行事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Eh? Lazy? Where are you going!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？懒散？你去哪儿了！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Ah, this is frustrating!
Adventurer! Listen to me! Listen to me and you'll be the judge of who's right. You know what these guys have been saying?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
啊，真让人火大！
冒险者，听我说！听完后你来判断谁对谁错。你知道他们刚才说什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Now, look at this ^0000CDpile of documents^000000 over here. You don't have to read it too carefully. Just look at the cover.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
看这边这^0000CD一大摞文件^000000。你不用仔细看，只要看看封面。

scripts.text: Rekenber... missing list..?
scripts.translation: 雷肯贝尔...失踪人员名单...？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Yeah. It's a list of ^0000CDmissing people^000000 who used to work at Rekenber. I've investigated everything as much as I could.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
没错。这是曾在雷肯贝尔工作、如今^0000CD失踪的人员名单^000000。能查的我都尽量查过了。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Even though I'm acquainted with the information, it's impossible to go deeper inside the Enterprise.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
虽然我掌握了这些情报，但还是没法深入雷肯贝尔公司内部。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
If I wanted to do this, I was cautioned to proceed legally to avoid causing more frictions.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
为了不让矛盾进一步激化，如果要调查，我就得按合法途径行事。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I believe the president has a relationship with the government and its businesses. So they have think carefully about this matters.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我觉得总裁和政府及其关联企业关系密切，所以他们处理这件事时必须格外谨慎。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
So when I met Kaya, I asked him to cooperate with me. You can help us in the yard, right?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
所以遇到卡雅时，我请他配合调查。在院子里帮帮我们，怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Because he's a Rekenber official, it should be easy for him to find this information right?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
他是雷肯贝尔的职员，应该很容易查到这些资料，对吧？

scripts.text: Right.
scripts.translation: 没错。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
But, well, I need you to check this out and cooperate with the investigation. You know how I get when I get thrown paper from the head office.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
不过，我需要你核对一下这些资料，配合调查。你知道总部一给我塞文件，我就会变成什么样。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
The employees on the list are assigned to another work station and they're in constant rotation.
Payments are also confirmed to be monthly basis.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
名单上的员工被调到其他工作地点，还会频繁轮换。
另外，已经确认他们每月都会领薪水。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
It's just common sense, why would a company go out their way to pay a salary to an unemployed person?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这不过是常识，一家公司为什么要费心给一个失业的人发工资呢？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I'm telling you it's common sense~
I can say common sense in front of people who have studied hard~
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我说了，这就是常识嘛~
我当然敢在那些努力读书的人面前讲常识~

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Wait, did I misunderstand the meaning of common sense?
Did I change the definition without knowing about it?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
等等，我是不是把“常识”理解错了？
难道我不知不觉改了它的定义？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
So either you're lying here, or I'm the one lying. Adventurer, am I the one lying?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
所以要么是你在撒谎，要么就是我在撒谎。冒险者，是我在撒谎吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
To sum it all up, we've lost many contacts to Rekenber's employees. Nobody really knows what happened to them.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
总而言之，我们和雷肯贝尔的许多员工失去了联系。没人知道他们究竟出了什么事。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
But they have such a long history?
The government just now realized about this issue. There's definitely a connection between that and the missing people. That's why I decided to investigate further.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
可雷肯贝尔明明是历史悠久的公司啊？政府竟然现在才意识到这个问题。这肯定和那些失踪者有关，所以我决定继续调查。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Who else would do the job if not me? That's why I have to investigate.
I have to do it in very legitimate way, Because I told him I would do it without causing friction.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这种事除了我还能有谁来做？所以我必须查下去。
既然答应过不会激化矛盾，我就得用合法的方式调查。

scripts.text: Are your results any different?
scripts.translation: 你的结果有什么不同吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
If you spend a long time as an adventurer, you can add 1 and 1 together. I see the scheme.
Yes, it's real.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
冒险者当久了，自然能把一加一算明白。我看穿他们的阴谋了。
没错，确实如此。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Yes, that's it. I'd like you to check again to figure out this mystery one and for all.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
对，就是这样。我想请你再核实一次，彻底解开这个谜团。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
That's why ^0000CDI don't do desk jobs^000000.
When I look at papers, I don't know how the world outside is doing.
I prefer going outside on the field and learn with my own eyes.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这就是为什么^0000CD我不做文职工作^000000。
看着文件，我就不知道外面的世界怎么样了。
我更喜欢去野外，亲眼去看看。

scripts.text: Do you want to go along with the investigation?
scripts.translation: 你想一起参与调查吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Do you think these guys who won't listen will go? Will you accompany me to search for the truth?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你觉得这些不肯听劝的人会去吗？你愿意陪我一起找出真相吗？

scripts.text: I'll be back as soon as possible.
scripts.translation: 我会尽快回来。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
No, no, Adventurer. You don't have to do such a thing. You just need to report the situation to me and do it the way I told you.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
不不，冒险者，不用你亲自做这种事。你只要向我汇报情况，照我说的去做就行。

scripts.text: Let me speak with them
scripts.translation: 让我去和他们谈谈

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Yeah, well, if you want to talk, come to me anytime, but don't be too hard on yourself~ the energy and time of the adventurer is important.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
好吧，你想聊的话随时来找我。不过别太勉强自己~冒险者的精力和时间都很宝贵。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I really like it here. Don't forget about the adventure, there's nothing to worry about.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我挺喜欢这里的。别忘了去冒险，没什么好担心的。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
What did he say? No, right?
See I told you. Persuading him is a waste of time. If you don't cooperate with me, there's no way I can report back to the President.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
他拒绝了吧？我就说嘛，劝他根本是浪费时间。你要是不配合我，我就没法向总裁汇报。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
His stiffness is stronger than bamboo. He's so rigid that his knees wouldn't bend.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
他固执得像竹子一样，膝盖硬得都弯不下来。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
If you don't cooperate with him and do it my way from now on,
The President will give you permission.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
只要你不再跟他合作，从现在起按我的方式做，总裁就会批准。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
If you asked the enterprise to cooperate with us, but what are you going to do if they refused?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
如果你请求雷肯贝尔配合调查，可他们拒绝了，你打算怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Hmm. Excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
嗯...抱歉，打扰一下。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Have you thought about it?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你考虑好了吗？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Please think it over, Vice President!
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
请再考虑一下，副总裁！

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
This is a waste of time, no matter how I look at it. Even if you told me a hundred times, it's not economical for me to go. But I accept your proposal anyway.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
在我看来，这就是浪费时间。你说一百遍，我也觉得不值得去。不过我还是接受你的提议。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Economical? Of course it's economical. I also like being economical. So, I can do this economically on my own terms? Yeah?
Dear Vice President?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
高效？当然高效。我也喜欢高效。那我就能按自己的方式高效处理这件事了，对吧？亲爱的副总裁？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Listen to me. I asked the government for help. I do agree that for us to trust each other, we must fully cooperate with one another.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
听我说，我已经向政府请求支援。我也同意，想要互相信任，就必须充分合作。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
If the only way to achieve that is by reviewing the people on the list, I will accept the condition.
^0000CDI will accompany you and actively cooperate.^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
如果要审查名单上的人员才能实现这一点，我接受这个条件。
^0000CD我会陪你一起去，并积极配合调查。^000000

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Please reconsider, Vice President.
You do not have to do that. I should go instead of you, no?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
请再考虑一下，副总裁。
您不必亲自去，让我代您去吧？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
There is a limit to what you can do. This is my responsibility and mine alone.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
你能做的事也有限。这是我的责任，只能由我来承担。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Do you even know how to travel and cooperate?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你们到底知不知道该怎么旅行、怎么合作？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Good. Let's forget about the past altercation and focus on the future. Thank you Vice President.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
很好，过去的争执就先放一边，专注接下来的事吧。谢谢你，副总裁。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
While the rest are analyzing what they've brought from the lab, the Vice President and I will go deal with the list.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
其他人继续分析从实验室带回的资料，我和副总裁去调查名单上的人。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Before we go on, there are two ^0000CDtwo conditions^000000 for this joint investigation.
First, please have at least ^0000CDa minimum amount of courtesy.^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
出发之前，我要先说明这次联合调查的两个^0000CD条件^000000。
第一，请至少保持^0000CD基本礼貌。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Oh, aren't you a ^0000CDVIP^000000?
Okay, thank you very much, VIP.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哦，您不是^0000CD贵宾^000000吗？
好吧，非常感谢您，贵宾。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Is it a hobby of yours to provoke other people?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
挑衅别人是您的爱好吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
If you don't like being called a VIP, then which title do you prefer?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
如果您不喜欢被叫作贵宾，那更喜欢什么头衔？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
... and second, I want a ^0000CDreliable person^000000 in your party.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
...第二，我希望你的队伍里有一位^0000CD可靠的伙伴。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
为什么？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I will need a witness in the future.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我以后需要一位见证人。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Oh I see, so you don't believe me?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哦，我明白了，所以您不相信我？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
If that's the requirement, I'll go!
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
如果需要人作证，我去！

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
You're already a witness on our side. You can't be a witness.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
你已经是我们这边的人了，不能当中立的见证人。

scripts.text: Then I'll go.
scripts.translation: 那我去。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Eh? Why the adventurer? If you're coming along, then you'll get to do all the fun parts...!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
咦？为什么是冒险者？你要是跟来，就能参与所有有趣的部分了...！

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
If me, {0} and Daisy are going, it will be a fair investigation.
Will both of our determinations combined, nothing can stop us.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我、{0}和黛西一起去，调查才算公正。我们三人齐心协力，就没人能阻止我们。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Wait, but what about your guard?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
等等，那您的卫兵怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I do not need a guard. I came here by myself the first time around. I will be just fine this time too.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我不需要卫兵。第一次来时我就是一个人，这次也没问题。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Very thoughtful. But you need to have a guard. It shouldn't be needed, but in case something goes wrong.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
考虑得真周到。不过您还是该带一名卫兵，以防万一。虽然不一定用得上，但总会有意外。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Even though I'm a very talented person, I have to prioritize my own safety first.
Look, I can take care of myself, and If I have to, I can tag along with the adventurer, but what about a VIP?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我虽然很有本事，也得先顾好自己的安全。
看，我能照顾好自己，必要时也能跟着冒险者。可贵宾怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
If you get hurt it will only cause a scandal. It would be bad! You know what I mean, right?
Plus we might not be able to get back right away, so it might get complicated.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
要是您受伤了，只会闹出丑闻，那就糟了！您明白吧？
而且我们可能没法马上回来，到时会更麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Yes, I'm definitely going!
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
是的，我一定会去！

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Well then I'll bring Aas with me...
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
那好吧，我带阿斯一起去...

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Also, it's really economical. Quick decision making, I like it.
So let's start with ^0000CDEinbroch^000000 at the <NAVI>[Airport]<INFO>einbroch,42,208,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
而且这样最有效率。我喜欢当机立断。
那就从^0000CD艾音布罗克^000000的<NAVI>[机场]<INFO>einbroch,42,208,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>开始吧。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
What are you doing here?.
Let's go to the <NAVI>[Einbroch Airport]<INFO>einbroch,42,208,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你在这里做什么？
我们去<NAVI>[艾音布罗克机场]<INFO>einbroch,42,208,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello. I'm back is everything fine?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我回来了。一切都还好吗？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Of course I can spare some time for someone who helped get back the laboratory. I really appreciate it.
But why have you come to see me?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
当然，我可以抽时间见见帮忙夺回实验室的人。我很感谢你。
不过，你来找我有什么事？

scripts.text: - You explain to Kaya, about what you and Lazy discussed. -
scripts.translation: - 你向卡雅说明了和懒散谈过的事。 -

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I understand what you mean, But Daisy's logic ^0000CDis too much^000000. I cannot doubt the ^0000CDcredibility of official documents,^000000 that's not just possible.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我明白你的意思，但黛西的说法^0000CD实在太过了。^000000我不可能怀疑^0000CD官方文件的可信度。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I have no intention of debating this further with you, so I'll talk to the person in charge.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我不想再和你争论这件事，我要去找负责人谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Who's the responsible one?
The person in front of me?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
负责人是谁？
是我面前这位吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
The president gave me his full authority on this matter.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
总裁把这件事的全权处理权交给我了。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
And who are you exactly?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
那你到底是什么人？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I already told you before, didn't I? Does the Vice President have a bad memory?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我不是早就告诉过你了吗？副总裁的记性这么差？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Why would I believe a man who gave me a fake name?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我为什么要相信一个连名字都用假的人？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
A name is just a name. If I was called Shit, would I become Shit when talking to the Vice President?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
名字只是个称呼。要是我叫“屎”，难道我跟副总裁说话时就变成“屎”了吗？

scripts.text: Is it your hobby to eavesdrop?
scripts.translation: 偷听是你的爱好吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Why? Isn't this where I should be?
Is it bad to listen? Don't bother with them it's not worth your time.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
为什么？我不该在这里吗？
听一下又怎么了？别理他们，不值得浪费时间。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
As Lazy was saying... Even if you called Lazy by Shit, Lazy would still be Lazy.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
懒散说得没错...就算把懒散叫作“屎”，他还是懒散。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Even if there is someone introduced Lazy as Shit, would you always view him as Shit for the rest of his life?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
即使有人把懒散介绍成“屎”，你就会一辈子把他当成“屎”吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now here's what really matters. If you do not tell the truth about what really happened, you'll not be able to get their cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
关键在这里：如果你不如实说明发生了什么，就得不到他们的合作。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Vice President, this is all about the Enterprise. Wouldn't it be nice to clear these doubts at once and for all, and show a better image of the Enterprise?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
副总裁，这件事关系到雷肯贝尔公司。趁现在彻底消除疑虑，展现公司更好的形象，不是很好吗？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I understand what you're saying, but you're wrong. We are telling you the truth and you're assuming we are lying.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我理解你的意思，但你错了。我们在告诉你真相，而你却认为我们在撒谎。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know everything that Lazy knows, but he seems to have better grasp at the situation than you do, Vice President.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不如懒散了解得多，但他似乎比您更清楚现在的情况，副总裁。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Lazy isn't the type of person that would spend time investigating these matter for no reason.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
懒散不是那种会无缘无故花时间调查这些事的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Lazy says he cannot believe the results the Vice President has provided, but do you not believe the results Reiji provided either, correct?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
懒散不相信副总裁给出的结果。不过，你也不相信雷吉给出的结果，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
We'd rather trust our results than those of Daisy.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我们宁愿相信自己的调查结果，也不信黛西的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How about this then? Why don't you two, who don't trust each other, see it for yourselves, together?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这样如何？既然你们互不信任，何不一起亲自去核实？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Investigate, together?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
一起调查？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
As Lazy said, he doesn't trust your findings.
If you can't believe in each other results, why don't you guys start from the beginning?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
正如懒散所说，他不相信你们的调查结果。既然不相信彼此的结论，为什么不从头一起查一遍？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you both investigate the differences between the reports, you'll know for sure which is accurate. A compromise must be done here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你们一起查清报告之间的差异，就能确认哪份更准确。双方都得各退一步。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
That's valid argument. But do I need to go too? I would prefer talking to you.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
这话有道理。不过我也必须去吗？我倒更想和你谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Can you believe what I've investigated so far? You still can't believe my findings, because you're assuming your documents are correct.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你相信我目前查到的结果吗？你还是不相信，因为你认定自己的文件不会错。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Yeah, no. I didn't think so.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
算了，我就知道你不会信。

scripts.text: Do you mind?
scripts.translation: 你介意吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I can't help it. We're wasting our time with them, why bother? What's wrong? Do you have nothing to say?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我也没办法。跟他们耗下去只是浪费时间，何必呢？怎么了？你还有话要说吗？

scripts.text: Please wait a moment, Lazy
scripts.translation: 请等一下，懒散

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I don't have much time to wait for this silliness.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我可没那么多时间陪你们胡闹。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
The results will be the same no matter how many times we check them. We have a lot of other work to do.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我们再怎么核查，结果也不会变。手头还有很多其他工作。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Vice President, you believe all the people in the Enterprise, right? But what will happen now?
With the current situation, nobody will believe your findings.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
副总裁，您相信公司里的所有人，对吧？可眼下这个局面呢？现在没人会相信您的调查结果。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If Lazy was wrong after the joint investigation, then you'd simply have wasted a bit of your time, but for the Vice President, it's a huge issue.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果联合调查证明懒散错了，你不过是多花了点时间；但对副总裁来说，事关重大。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
... Please give me a few minutes to consider my options.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
...请给我几分钟时间考虑一下。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Daisy's opinion is hard to accept, but the logic behind it... is correct. I think I'll give it a try.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
黛西的观点很难接受，但她的推理...确实有道理。我想试试看。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Didn't you come here to find Daisy?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
你不是来找黛西的吗？

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Oh, this place is so peaceful.
You look pale.
...
It's a joke, I think I need more time to properly investigate this area.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃尔科娃]
哎呀，这里真安静。
你脸色怎么这么苍白？
...
开个玩笑。我想还得再花些时间，才能彻底调查这片区域。

scripts.text: Is there any problem?
scripts.translation: 有什么问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
They said barriers were built because the factory closed.
Something doesn't feel right here though.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃尔科娃]
听说工厂关闭后，这里才建起屏障。
不过总觉得有些不对劲。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Anyway, I should go beyond the barrier to get satisfying information for Tes?
My crew is working on securing the doorway first. If you open it, go check out the other side.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃尔科娃]
总之，我得越过屏障，找出能让泰斯满意的情报。
我的队员正在设法打开入口。门一开，你就去另一边看看。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
You remember Lucky? I brought him along, so go ahead and ask him about the progress.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃尔科娃]
你还记得拉基吗？我把他也带来了，去问问他进展如何。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
I need to find out what's beyond the barrier.
If there's nothing special, I'll just leave. But if there is something there at all, Should I use my full strength?
Of course, I like the latter.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃尔科娃]
我得查清屏障后面有什么。
如果没什么特别的，我就离开；但要是真有什么东西，我是不是该全力以赴？
当然，我更喜欢后一种情况。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Have you investigated beyond the barrier?
If something suspicious comes up, Leave it to me!
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃尔科娃]
你调查过屏障另一边了吗？
要是发现可疑情况，就交给我！

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Now, it's finally Elena Volkova's time to shine!
Adventurer, return to Cat on Bullet and tell Tes what happened here.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃尔科娃]
终于轮到我埃琳娜·沃尔科娃大显身手了！
冒险者，回“子弹上的猫”酒吧，把这里的情况告诉泰斯。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
There is no difference whether you report it or someone else does.
This place is just a dump.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃尔科娃]
是你报告还是别人报告，没什么区别。
这里只是个垃圾场。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
The USU will manage somehow, go ahead and report back to Tes about the situation.
In the meantime, I have to help out my team.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃尔科娃]
USU会想办法处理的。你先去向泰斯汇报这里的情况吧。
我还得去帮队员们。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
This area is nothing but a disposal facility.
It's where they throw away their failed experiments.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃尔科娃]
这个区域不过是个废弃物处理设施。
他们把失败的实验品都扔在这里。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
It would be great if those guys went outside the barrier.
I haven't trained today!
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃尔科娃]
要是那些家伙肯走出屏障就好了。
我今天还没训练呢！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Are you an adventurer?
Did Tes send you? If you want more information, you'll have to find it yourself.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你是冒险者吗？
泰斯派你来的？想知道更多，就自己去找线索吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Would you look at this place?
It's a triple-edged door. I'm having a hard time opening it up.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你看这是什么？
这是三重门，我费了好大劲才打开。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Of course, if you use magic like Teleport or Fly Wings, you can get past it.
We have a lot of people with us though... *laughs*
Wouldn't you prefer to go in directly with your own two legs?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
当然，你也可以用瞬间移动或苍蝇翅膀之类的魔法过去。
不过我们人多嘛...（笑）
你不想自己走进去看看吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Other rebellion members are already looking for an entry point. If you don't mind, can you check on them?
Maybe you'll find something out.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
其他反叛者已经在找入口了。方便的话，去看看他们那边的情况吧。
说不定会有发现。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The abandoned mine is beyond this barrier. Be careful.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
废弃矿坑就在这道屏障的另一边。请小心。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Other rebellion members are already looking for an entry point. If you don't mind, look for them adventurer.
Maybe you'll find something out.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
其他反叛者已经在找入口了。方便的话，冒险者，去找找他们吧。
说不定会有发现。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The abandoned mine is beyond this barrier. Be careful.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
废弃矿坑就在这道屏障的另一边。请小心。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hey... So you found a watchtower and Small Hole?
A Small Hole so small, that a human couldn't have pass it? Ahaha...
That's too bad.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嘿...你找到瞭望塔和那个小洞了吗？
小洞那么小，人根本钻不过去？哈哈...
真遗憾。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If I could use that Small Hole, my efforts would be in vain wouldn't they?
Don't be disappointed!
I finally unlocked this door.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
要是能从那个小洞过去，我的努力不就白费了吗？
别失望！
我终于把这扇门打开了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
This button right here opens the door, but the moment you release it, the door closes.
Does that mean there's no way for a single person to cross on the other side?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
这个按钮能开门，可一松手门就关上了。
看来一个人没法独自通过到另一边？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Even if you come with 2 people...
This is awkward.
It seems to have been made with the intention of 'throwing in'.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
就算两个人一起...
也挺尴尬的。
这装置看起来就是为了把人“扔进去”而设计的。

scripts.text: Throwing in?
scripts.translation: 扔进去？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
There is a place like this with similar devices.
A prison. A jail. It's for prisoners... What is this place?!
What is it? Are we in a criminal camp?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
有个地方也用类似的装置。
监狱、牢房...都是关囚犯的地方。这到底是什么地方？！
难道这里是关罪犯的营地？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
No that's not it. If it was such a facility, Tes wouldn't have known about it.
Well, for now, you should just go in.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不，不可能。如果真是那种地方，泰斯不可能不知道。
总之，你先进去看看。

scripts.text: I hear suspicious sounds...
scripts.translation: 我听到可疑的声音...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Well? Aaah! I heard that. These are strange screams? So the other members went in.
I'll stay here to manage the switch while you go on the other side.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
怎么样？啊，我听到了！那是奇怪的尖叫声吗？看来其他队员已经进去了。
我留在这里操作开关，你去另一边看看。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Are you going to join the others too?
If you find the sources of the noises, see monsters, or anything else out of ordinary, please let me know!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你也要去和其他人会合吗？
要是找到声音来源、发现魔物或其他异常情况，记得告诉我！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
When you want to come out, do 'tock-tock-tock' on the other side and knock on the iron door three times.
I'll open the door from my end.
Of course you can also use magic to get out... Ahaha.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
想出来时，在另一边敲三下铁门，发出“咚、咚、咚”的声音。
我会从这边开门。
当然，你也可以用魔法出来...哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Other rebellion members have already entered.
We can't just leave them alone.
Be careful.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
其他反叛者成员已经进去了。
我们不能就这样丢下他们不管。
请小心。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Woah... what happened in there?
You look exhausted...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哇...里面发生什么事了？
你看起来累坏了...

scripts.text: The monsters came out.
scripts.translation: 魔物跑出来了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The monsters!?
Let's report to Elena! Then, return to Cat on Bullet and report back to Tes!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
魔物？！
快去告诉埃琳娜！然后回“子弹上的猫”酒吧向泰斯汇报！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Do you think the monsters can get out from the small gap?
I'll stay here and return with Elena in a bit!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你觉得魔物能从那个小缝里出来吗？
我留在这里，待会儿和埃琳娜一起回去！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It's nice to suddenly have so much work to do... But I won't be able to do everything on my own...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
突然有这么多事要做还挺好...不过我一个人肯定忙不过来...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
Well? Are you involved with the operation?
Even though I live in Einbroch,
This is the first time I've seen it.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
怎么样？你也参与这次行动了吗？
我虽然住在艾音布罗克，
但还是第一次见到这种场面。

scripts.text: What's wrong?
scripts.translation: 怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
Look over here, is it not strange?
It's a railway to carry minerals, but they've built a barrier on top.
It doesn't even have a door.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
你看那边，难道不觉得奇怪吗？
那条铁路是用来运矿石的，上面却建了一道屏障，
甚至连门都没有。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
At first I thought this wall was meant to separate the smelting factory and the mine...
But I don't think it is?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
起初我以为这堵墙是用来隔开冶炼厂和矿场的...
但好像不是？

scripts.text: Was the barrier created afterwards?
scripts.translation: 屏障是后来建的吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
For sure.
But why do you need a barrier to an already closed mine and factory?
And this type of structure is what's used in prisons.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
肯定是后来建的。
可是矿场和工厂都封闭了，为什么还要建屏障？
而且这种结构通常是监狱才有的。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
I don't know the purpose of this wall, but it was not built while the factory was still running.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
我不知道建这堵墙是为了什么，但可以肯定，工厂还在运营时它并不存在。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
I'll have a closer look and join you later.
Please tell Lucky.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
我再仔细查查，之后和你们会合。
记得告诉拉基。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
I have to look a bit more.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
我得再仔细看看。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
Well? What is the adventurer doing here?
Are you part of the operation too?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
怎么样？冒险者，你怎么会在这里？
你也参加了行动吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
Oh! I'll let you know what I found here.
Do you see this big column?
I went on top of it, the watchtower!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
哦！我来告诉你我的发现。
看到那根大柱子了吗？
我爬上去看了看，原来是座瞭望塔！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
It looks better than the barrier.
I don't know why there's a watchtower in smelting facility, but it's definitely a watchtower!
This is the discovery of the century. Ahaha!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
从那里看屏障更清楚。我不知道冶炼厂里为什么会有瞭望塔，但那绝对是瞭望塔！
这可是本世纪的大发现啊，哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
When I was looking up there, I think I saw something move.
I'm going to make sure of what I saw by going back up!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
我刚才在上面时，好像看到有东西动了一下。
我再爬上去确认一下！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
I will learn everything I can about the watchtower! You can report back to Lucky!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
我会把瞭望塔查个清楚！你先回去向拉基汇报吧！

scripts.text:
There is a small enough hole just barely enough for a child to go through.
It seems like an animal has dug this hole and made a little cave.
Let's have another look around.
scripts.translation:
这里有个小洞，刚好能让小孩勉强钻过去。
看起来是动物挖出的洞，里面还形成了一个小洞穴。
再去周围看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Oh!
Are you back already?
Did you find it?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
哦！
你这么快就回来了？
找到照片了吗？

scripts.text: Hand over the picture
scripts.translation: 交出照片

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Thank you.
You may think it's not worth much, but it means a lot to me...
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
谢谢你。
你可能觉得它不值什么钱，但对我来说意义重大...

scripts.text:
[Dien]
What's with that expression...?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
你这是什么表情...？

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
I've never seen that in the room.
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
我以前从没在房间里见过那个。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Ahah...
It's a souvenir of us when we were children.
Was it always like that?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
啊哈...
这是我们小时候留下的纪念品。
它一直都是这样吗？

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Were we really so loud?
Anyway, we've opened the door, let's go.
I think people are coming.
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
我们刚才真的那么吵吗？
不管怎样，门已经开了，我们走吧。
我好像听到有人来了。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
It's been a while since I have been this excited.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
我好久没这么兴奋过了。

scripts.text: Chat with Morning.
scripts.translation: 和莫宁聊聊

scripts.text: Find a meal for Morning.
scripts.translation: 给莫宁找点吃的

scripts.text: Chat with Morning.
scripts.translation: 和莫宁聊聊

scripts.text: I'll bring it.
scripts.translation: 我去拿

scripts.text: Something urgent happened.
scripts.translation: 出事了，情况紧急

scripts.text: A lot of garbage is piled up around this rock. It seems to have been there for a while too. Let's dig the ground.
scripts.translation: 周围堆着很多垃圾，看起来已经放了好一阵子。挖挖地面看看吧。

scripts.text: Dig.
scripts.translation: 挖掘

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: I searched the ground and found a note someone buried.
scripts.translation: 我在地上找了找，发现一张别人埋下的纸条。

scripts.text: A lot of garbage is piled up around this rock. It seems to have been there for a while too. Let's dig the ground.
scripts.translation: 周围堆着很多垃圾，看起来已经放了好一阵子。挖挖地面看看吧。

scripts.text: Dig.
scripts.translation: 挖掘

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Someone seems to have already dug this place.
scripts.translation: 看来这里已经被人挖过了。

scripts.text:
[Advance Squad]
It's dangerous for you to be in a place like this. Even for experienced people. Please come back next time.
scripts.translation:
[先遣队]
这里很危险，即使是经验丰富的人也不该贸然前来。请下次再来。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Show me the way out!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
快告诉我怎么出去！

scripts.text:
[Worker]
So these gunmen think they can just come here and suddenly start a commotion!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
这些枪手以为自己能随便闯进来、惹出乱子吗！

scripts.text:
[Advance Squad]
Gentlemen, please don't do this. We didn't come here to harm you.
scripts.translation:
[先遣队]
各位，请冷静。我们不是来伤害你们的。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Of course not. We're just getting attacked by you, rebellions.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
当然不是！可你们这些反叛者正在攻击我们。

scripts.text:
[Advance Squad]
Being emotional doesn't help resolve problems.
scripts.translation:
[先遣队]
激动也解决不了问题。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Are you threatening us now?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
你们这是在威胁我们吗？

scripts.text: What's going in?
scripts.translation: 发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Advance Squad]
Aah! You're alive! Adventurer! Is anyone with you?
scripts.translation:
[先遣队]
啊！你还活着！冒险者，你是一个人来的吗？

scripts.text: I'm the first to arrive...
scripts.translation: 我第一个到...

scripts.text:
[Advance Squad]
I sent a person to pick the person in charge. We are the Advance Squad who was sent here to search and recon this place, but as you can see...
scripts.translation:
[先遣队]
我派人去找负责人了。我们是奉命来这里搜查和侦察的先遣队，可你也看到了...

scripts.text: Who are these people?
scripts.translation: 这些人是谁？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Is this the person responsible for all of this?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
这些事都是你们干的吗？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
I don't think so? That person looks dumb.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我看不像吧？那个人看起来傻乎乎的。

scripts.text:
[Advance Squad]
They are the ^0000CDpeople who's working here^000000.
As you can see, we didn't harm them...
scripts.translation:
[先遣队]
他们是^0000CD在这里工作的员工^000000。
你也看到了，我们没有伤害他们...

scripts.text:
[Advance Squad]
We really don't know what to do.
There are ^0000FFthe lab workers^000000
who does chores around here, and when we tried to enter they stopped us.
scripts.translation:
[先遣队]
我们也不知道该怎么办。
这些^0000FF实验室杂工^000000平时负责打杂，我们一想进去就被他们拦住了。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
What are you saying does chores?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
你说谁是杂工？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Why do you guys judge the work of others? You aren't in charge, are you?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
你们凭什么评判别人的工作？你们又不是负责人。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
I think you're just ignorant people who don't know anything.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我看你们根本什么都不懂。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Come on, they're all gunmen!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
拜托！他们全都拿着枪呢！

scripts.text:
[Advance Squad]
That's not it! We want to protect the civilians and make things right!
scripts.translation:
[先遣队]
不是这样的！我们是来保护平民、解决问题的！

scripts.text:
[Worker]
If we refuse to comply, what's gonna happen? Are you going to shoot us?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我们要是不配合会怎样？你们要开枪打我们吗？

scripts.text: Why are you blocking the road?
scripts.translation: 你们为什么挡路？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Why not? If someone came into your home, would you just let them in?
These people are out of their minds and are making a mess.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
为什么不能挡？有人闯进你家，你会直接放他们进来吗？
这些人疯了，还把这里搞得一团糟。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
See! Why are you sticking your nose into other people's business?
That's it! Get out! Get out now!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
看吧！你们为什么要插手别人的事？
够了！出去！马上出去！

scripts.text:
[Advance Squad]
Perhaps you don't know, but this ^0000FFlab was doing illegal experiments.^000000
We have came to arrest the people responsible in cooperation with the Government and Rekenber.
scripts.translation:
[先遣队]
也许你不知道，但这座^0000FF实验室正在进行非法实验。^000000
我们正与政府和雷肯贝尔合作，前来逮捕相关人员。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
What? What do you mean illegal experiments? Can you tell us where these illegal experiments were done?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
什么叫非法实验？你能说清楚这些实验到底在哪里进行吗？

scripts.text:
[Advance Squad]
I know it's hard to believe, I'm having a hard time to believe it myself, but this is the place that was used to run illegal experiments.
scripts.translation:
[先遣队]
我知道这很难相信，我自己也不敢相信，但这里确实被用来进行非法实验。

scripts.text: Who owns this mansion?
scripts.translation: 这座宅邸是谁的？

scripts.text: I don't see any researchers here.
scripts.translation: 我没看到研究员。

scripts.text:
[Advance Squad]
Perhaps they ^0000FFescaped to the mansion.^000000
scripts.translation:
[先遣队]
也许他们^0000FF逃进宅邸里了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Advance Squad]
These people look like the manual workforce, they are not researchers.
scripts.translation:
[先遣队]
这些人看起来只是普通劳工，并不是研究员。

scripts.text:
[Advance Squad]
The people and the materials that are left behind in the rush of escaping are likely the good people left.
scripts.translation:
[先遣队]
仓促逃离时留下这些员工和物资的，想必都是无辜的。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
What are you saying about us?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
你们在说我们什么？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
What? Are we just garbage you can just throw away?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
什么？我们就像垃圾一样可以随便丢下吗？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
How many researcher are like us!
They can't keep this place running without us!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
像我们这样的工人有多少！
没有我们，他们根本运转不了这里！

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Get out now! This is Rekenber's laboratory! You're trespassing on private property!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
马上滚出去！这是雷肯贝尔的实验室！你们这是私闯私人领地！

scripts.text:
[Advance Squad]
What? What are we supposed to do now. We can't use force against unarmed civilians.
scripts.translation:
[先遣队]
这...我们现在该怎么办？总不能对手无寸铁的平民动武。

scripts.text: I would never hurt you guys.
scripts.translation: 我绝不会伤害你们。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Why should we stand back? You're the invaders!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
凭什么让我们退后？你们才是闯入者！

scripts.text:
[Worker]
I don't want anybody to get hurt, you will hurt us with your weapons!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我不想任何人受伤！你们的武器会伤到我们的！

scripts.text:
[Advance Squad]
Should we charge in?
scripts.translation:
[先遣队]
我们要冲进去吗？

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Why would you charge in without orders?
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
没有命令，你们为什么要冲进去？

scripts.text: Vice President! Tes!
scripts.translation: 副总裁！泰斯！

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Why do you keep coming? Get out! Get out!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
你们怎么还在纠缠？出去！快出去！

scripts.text:
[Advance Squad]
These are employees who help the laboratory run, but they do not believe when I tell them they've been conducting illegal experiments.
scripts.translation:
[先遣队]
他们是负责实验室日常运作的员工，可我告诉他们这里在进行非法实验，他们根本不信。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Alright. Let me talk to them.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
好，让我来和他们谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Who are you now?!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
你又是谁？！

scripts.text:
[Advance Squad]
The Vice President wants to talk to them.
scripts.translation:
[先遣队]
副总裁想和你们谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Advance Squad]
Head to the safe location, hurry!
scripts.translation:
[先遣队]
快去安全地点！

scripts.text:
[Advanced Team]
Adventurer, it's dangerous here. Proceed to the safe location.
scripts.translation:
[先遣队]
冒险者，这里很危险。请前往安全地点。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Hello everyone, I'm Kaya Tos, Rekenber's Vice President.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
大家好，我是卡雅·托斯，雷肯贝尔的副总裁。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Vice President? The Vice President?
Isn't that another one of your lies?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
副总裁？
这又是你们编的谎话吧？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Huh? I know him! That is indeed Kaya, The Vice President.
When I was at the headquarters, I saw him a few times.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
啊？我认识他！那确实是副总裁卡雅。
我在总部时见过他几次。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Oh, really? I didn't know because I had never seen your face before.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
哦，原来如此。我以前没见过你，所以不知道。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Why is the Vice President here?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
副总裁怎么会在这里？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Were you all hired by the Rekenber institute to work on constructing and maintenance in this new lab?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
你们是受雷肯贝尔研究所雇佣，来建造和维护这座新实验室的吗？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
That's correct.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
没错。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Yes, I've been hired by Rekenber.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
对，我是雷肯贝尔雇来的。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
What did the person wearing blue clothes over here do here?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
那边穿蓝衣服的人，你在这里负责什么工作？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Me? Well... I'm responsible for making and delivering foods to the people working here.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我吗？嗯...我负责给这里的工作人员做饭、送饭。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
And what about the person next to you?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
那你旁边这位呢？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
I carry waste materials and laboratory equipment.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我负责搬运废料和实验室设备。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
If you know what this place is studying, please raise your hand.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
你们知道这里究竟在研究什么吗？知道的话请举手。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Well... renewable energy?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
嗯...可再生能源？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Oh I know! Wasn't it agricultural research?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我知道！不是在做农业研究吗？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
It looks like livestock study.
Sometimes strange beasts roam by.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
看起来像是畜牧研究。
有时还会有奇怪的野兽经过。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
While you do your own work, you don't know what this place is really for. in fact, I'm glad it's like that.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
你们只管做好自己的工作，并不知道这里真正的用途。说实话，我很庆幸如此。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
This facility is doing illegal experiments that are strictly forbidden by the government and Rekenber.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
这个设施正在进行政府和雷肯贝尔都严令禁止的非法实验。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
You mean, our researchers...? No way.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
你是说我们的研究员...？怎么可能。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Those people were doing experiments outside of the law?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
那些人是在做非法实验吗？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
What illegal experiments?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
什么非法实验？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
That, I don't know in details yet.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
具体细节，我目前还不太清楚。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Can't you tell us more about what they've been doing?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
你能不能多告诉我们一些他们做了什么？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
You guys are supposed to be the good guys, then why do you call us the bad guys?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
你们不是应该代表正义的一方吗？为什么把我们当成坏人？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Exactly! That means these people have done bad things? Are the high members of Rekenber just going to come in and take the results of our scientists' research?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
没错！这说明那些人做了坏事？难道雷肯贝尔的高层成员会直接进来，拿走我们科学家的研究成果吗？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Right? Otherwise, the Vice President wouldn't have brought the Rebellions, but the guards instead.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
对吧？否则，副总裁不会派反叛者来，而是派卫兵。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Are they really from the Enterprise? Why did the Vice President come here without the operatives?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
他们真是公司的人吗？副总裁怎么没带特工来？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Are you acting alone?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
你是独自行动的吗？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
He does look like the Vice President though.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
不过，他看起来确实像副总裁。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
This is a big problem. They don't believe us at all.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
这是个严重的问题。他们完全不相信我们。

scripts.text:
[Advance Squad]
I mean, how do you think the researchers have brainwashed these people over the years?
scripts.translation:
[先遣队]
我是说，你觉得研究员们是怎么在这么多年里洗脑这些人的？

scripts.text:
[Tes]
I'll talk to them, let me try.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
我来跟他们谈谈，让我试试。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Hello everyone. My name is Tes, I'm fron the office of the President of Schwarzwald.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
大家好。我是泰斯，来自修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德总裁办公室。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Some time ago, the Rekenber's laboratories have been under investigation because of their illegal experiments.
We've been cooperating with the Vice President over here.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
不久前，雷肯贝尔的实验室因非法实验接受了调查。
我们一直在和这里的副总裁合作。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
The Regenschirm lab, back at Rekenber, was involved with similar experiments and it caused a turmoil.
If you refuse to cooperate, you will be charged with illegal acts and  your refusal to cooperate.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
雷肯贝尔旗下的雷根修芦实验室也曾进行类似实验，并因此引发骚乱。
如果你们拒绝配合，就会因非法行为和拒不配合而受到指控。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Are you threatening us now?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
你们这是在威胁我们吗？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
No way! have we done anything wrong?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
不可能！我们做错什么了吗？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
This is our only job!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
这是我们唯一的工作！

scripts.text:
[Worker]
What gives you the right to just come here and charge us? We've been living her quietly for years. Did we sin?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
你们凭什么跑来这里指控我们？我们在这里安安稳稳生活了这么多年，犯什么罪了？

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Look around you. Even though you're having a hard time here, can you see any researcher trying to explain themselves?
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
看看周围。你们在这里过得这么艰难，可有哪个研究员站出来解释过？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Oh, they're just busy!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
啊，他们只是太忙了！

scripts.text:
[Worker]
They aren't as free as you are, they have work to do!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
他们不像你们那么清闲，他们还有工作要做呢！

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
There are no words to convince them.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
看来言语是无法说服他们的。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Hmmm... I won't be able to conclude this easily, let's take a moment to discuss.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
嗯...看来没法轻易说服他们。我们先商量一下。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
No matter how much I tried to persuade them, they didn't listen. It's not easy to change someone's mind. I should discuss it with Tes.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
无论我怎么劝说，他们都不肯听。改变一个人的想法并不容易。我应该和泰斯商量一下。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
The Vice President, Kaya Tos, is going to persuade them. Let's listen to him.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
副总裁卡雅·托斯要去劝他们。我们听听他怎么说。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
I can't get through to them just with words.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
光靠言语是无法让他们回头的。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
You cannot use force against innocent people.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
你不能对无辜的人使用武力。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Even so, we might have to. We split in two teams, one of them keeps them from pursuing, and the rest enter and keep investigating.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
即便如此，恐怕也只能这么办。我们分成两队，一队拦住他们，另一队进去继续调查。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
That sounds like a good idea.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
这个主意听起来不错。

scripts.text:
[????]
Don't move!

[????]
Everything here is mine! I won't let you harm my friends! I'm not messing around!
scripts.translation:
[????]
这里的一切都是我的！别想伤害我的朋友！我可不是在开玩笑！

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Huh, senior researcher?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
咦，高级研究员？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Elyumina?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
艾露米娜？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Who gave you permission to approach my staff? You see them? Just try putting one hand on them, and I'll blow you up.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
谁允许你靠近我的职员了？你看到了吗？只要敢碰他们一下，我就把你炸上天。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
No matter how stupid you are, it's always better to have your hands on your wrists, right?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
再蠢也该知道，手还是长在自己手腕上比较好吧？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Everyone get back! It's dangerous!
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
大家退后！这里很危险！

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
You all look like skeletons, why aren't you hiding? You will all disappear!
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
你们看起来都瘦成骷髅了，怎么还不躲起来？你们会全都消失的！

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Aaaaah!! Researcher! It's us! We're here too!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
啊啊啊！！研究员！是我们！我们也在！

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
You know what! If you have soybeans and rice, which one do you choose?
If you're in a hurry, you'll just mix them up!
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
你知道吗！黄豆和大米，你会选哪个？
赶时间的话，就把它们混在一起！

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Why are you doing this?!!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
你们为什么要这么做？！！

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Move behind me! Now!
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
躲到我身后！快！

scripts.text:
[Advance Squad]
Everyone, formation!
scripts.translation:
[先遣队]
大家，列阵！

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Argh...
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
啊...

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
What, what? Come on? Why is our attack.. not working...?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
怎么回事？我们的攻击...为什么没用...？

scripts.text:
[Fool 1]
Dodge it!
scripts.translation:
[傻瓜 1]
躲开它！

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Why? Why are they not budging? What about this?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
为什么？为什么他们纹丝不动？那这个呢？

scripts.text:
[Fool 2]
Oh, I've been hit! We should escape!
scripts.translation:
[傻瓜 2]
哦，我被击中了！我们快逃吧！

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Why are they doing so well? Did we pick the wrong test subjects?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
他们怎么这么能打？难道我们挑错实验对象了？

scripts.text:
[Fool 1]
These people are professionals!
scripts.translation:
[傻瓜 1]
这些人可是专业人士！

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
You are professionals too!
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
你们也是专业人士！

scripts.text:
[Fool 2]
I'm also a high-end pro who gets money!! We don't have time to decide who's superior! Hurry up!
scripts.translation:
[傻瓜 2]
我也是收钱办事的专业人士！！没空争谁更厉害了，快跑！

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
No! Let me go! Now! I can't believe we can't avoid that kind of weapon! Let me go! Let me go!!
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
不！快让我走！我可不想挨那种武器的打！放开我！放开我！！

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Is everyone alright?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
大家都没事吧？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I'm okay, but the others...
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我没事，但是其他人...

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Huh.. uh...

[Worker]
Ah.. argh!! I'm... gonna die!!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
啊...啊啊！！我...我要死了！！

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I'll move the people to a safe location.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我会把伤员转移到安全的地方。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Let the rest of the people here look at where they went.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
让剩下的人在这里查看他们去了哪里。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Some should stay here to watch out in case they come back, the rest of us will head to the <NAVI>[safe place]<INFO>sp_cor,122,141,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>!
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
留几个人在这里警戒，以防他们回来。其他人跟我去<NAVI>[安全地点]<INFO>sp_cor,122,141,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>！

scripts.text:
[Advance Squad]
This place is incredibly nice looking, it's hard to believe they do experiments here. Even I would want to live in a place like this.
scripts.translation:
[先遣队]
这里的环境看起来非常好，很难相信他们在这里进行实验。换作是我，也会想住在这种地方。

scripts.text:
[Advance Squad]
The problem is. We can't use force on them. What should we do?
scripts.translation:
[先遣队]
问题是，我们不能对他们动武。接下来怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Advance Squad]
Didn't you say the Vice President of Rekenber was going to convince them? What do you want to talk to me about?
scripts.translation:
[先遣队]
你不是说雷肯贝尔的副总裁会去劝他们吗？找我有什么事？

scripts.text:
[Advance Squad]
I don't think this is going to work. What do you think Tes will say? The fight is still going on.
scripts.translation:
[先遣队]
我看这样不行。泰斯会怎么决定？那边还在打呢。

scripts.text:
[Advance Squad]
It's dangerous here. Move over to the safe area!
scripts.translation:
[先遣队]
这里很危险。快转移到安全区域去！

scripts.text:
[Aas]
The Vice President is going to convince them.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
副总裁会去劝服他们的。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Didn't Tes tell you to take action? If you aren't prepared, you should do that now.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
泰斯不是让你采取行动吗？如果你还没准备好，那就现在准备。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
I'm so curious what the inside looks like~
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
我很好奇里面是什么样子的~

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Wait, something's not right?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
等等，有什么不对劲吗？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
These people aren't armed? What are they playing at?
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
这些人没有携带武器？他们在搞什么鬼？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I don't feel so well. We should get ready.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
我有种不祥的预感。我们得做好准备。

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
It's nice here and quiet. If only I could get a day off...
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
这里很安静，也很舒服。要是能请一天假就好了...

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
What is this big mansion in front of us? I've never seen anything like this before.
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
前面那座大宅子是什么？我以前从未见过这样的地方。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Who said it? Who's going to kick our butts?!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
谁说的？谁要揍我们？！

scripts.text:
[Worker]
I came out to see what was that commotion, what is happening?!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我出来看看是什么动静，到底发生什么事了？！

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Are you seeing this? Show yourselves! Come on out!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
你们看到了吗？出来吧！别躲躲藏藏的！

scripts.text:
[Worker]
I don't know why I keep standing here. If they asked something, I just decline. They're stamina monsters.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我不知道为什么我一直站在这里。如果他们问什么，我就拒绝。他们的体力真好。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Today is supposed to be day off, but what is this! Are you responsible for it commotion?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
今天本来是休息日，怎么闹成这样！这场骚动是你们引起的吗？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
I'll have a warm drink when this is over!!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
等这一切结束后，我要喝杯热饮！！

scripts.text:
[Tes]
This may be hard for you, but please investigate the entrance first.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
这事可能有点棘手，但请先去调查入口。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Is everyone alright?
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
大家都没事吧？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
No, really, just a little bit, I'm late am I? What is this all about, is it drugs?
Was I really this late? What is all of this, why is everyone wounded?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
不是...就迟到了一小会儿。我迟到了吗？这到底怎么回事，是毒品吗？
我真的来晚这么多吗？怎么回事，大家怎么都受伤了？

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Can't you tell from what you can see? Help with the work if you are free, there's no time to explain.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
你看不到吗？如果有空就帮忙干活，没时间解释了。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Hey, I was worried about all of this!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
喂，我刚才可是一直在担心大家！

scripts.text:
[Worker]
I can't... the chief researcher attacked us.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我不行了...是首席研究员袭击了我们。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
I was the one who made all this stuff and never once questioned it...
scripts.translation:
[工人]
这些东西都是我做的，我却从来没怀疑过...

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Why us...
scripts.translation:
[工人]
为什么是我们...

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Hey, don't say that.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
喂，别这么说。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Do you still trust the researchers? Is that what you're saying?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
你还信那些研究员吗？你是这个意思吗？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
No that's not it, I just can't believe it. Ugh, I'm so tired...
scripts.translation:
[工人]
不，不是那样，我只是不敢相信。唉，我好累...

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Please stay here, I will check the surroundings.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
请留在这里，我去周围查看一下。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Take a look at the condition of the injured.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
去看看伤员的情况。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
